# PYNQ v2.4 audio reference

Unmodified iis_ser.vhd and iis_deser.vhd from Xilinx/PYNQ tag v2.4:
https://github.com/Xilinx/PYNQ/tree/v2.4/boards/ip/audio_codec_ctrl_v1.0/src

LICENSE copied from the repository root (BSD-3-Clause). Preserve these notices when distributing. Retrieved 2026-10-14. Source release base.tcl explicitly targets Vivado 2018.3.
The original deserializer includes a TODO concerning VALID timing; integration must be tested, not assumed correct.
